description: Opaque muted teal-blue floor-length overdress over a cream linen underdress, with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Fine gold cloud and curling geometric woven patterns decorate the bodice, vertical opening, sleeve ends and hem. Several small round gold clasps run down the bodice front. A dark brown woven waist sash has gold ornaments, an ornate round clasp and long cream and gold tassel-ended ties. An olive-brown wrap rests on both forearms and hangs at the sides, edged with gold and teal patterns. Cream inner sleeves are visible. Brown closed leather boots show beneath the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
